requirements.title: Image Diff & Visual Comparison
requirements.description: General-purpose image diff/visual-comparison op built as a first-class capability so test-genie can later adopt it without duplication. Pure-Go (no model): pixel metrics (changed-pixel fraction + MAE/RMSE/PSNR), perceptual metrics (DCT pHash distance + structural similarity), and a heat-map overlay. Proto DiffService + REST POST /api/v1/diff/compare edge + CLI `diff` + UI Compare view.

validation.notes: Pixel + perceptual diff: identical/different/tolerance/dimension-mismatch verdicts, pHash robust to re-encode, heat-map highlights changed regions.
Compare edge end-to-end: two-image multipart → DiffResult + stored heat-map blob; metrics-only opt-out; missing-part/undecodable/bad-params errors.
